  Scenario: AC12 The service reads no ACE view, no other service's schema and no recovery table (new, D-RCV-60)

    Given the caller presents no valid credential
    When the caller asks POST /api/recovery/access/v1/authorise for area "CASE_RECORD", right "R", case "RW-2026-000410" and field "DF-ACE-281"
    Then the answer is status 401 and carries no masking answer, no product, no product status and no account number
    Then the same call to GET /api/recovery/access/v1/masking-policies for field "DF-ACE-281" is answered with status 401 and no row
